effect: Supplement point-weather learning with a forecast-family learner evaluated on source-supported reported-temperature intervals.
carrier: NWS exact response pages -> station temperature-report cells -> prospective station science outcomes and matched family comparisons -> new weighted forecast law. Existing point forecasts and fits retained.
shall: No inference of reporting precision from an integer API temperature or a five-minute clock alone.
Use validated same-station/time raw METAR tenths/whole encodings; keep unknown precision and contradictions as witnesses.

New learner uses past received paired upper excess losses, date weighting, fixed untrained prior/rate and explicit separate verification.
Exclude target observations already occurring at publication; never use future cell or score receipts.
Demonstrate changed weights and forecasts under deterministic prequential inputs, then publish new hypotheses via Cold Red Gate without claiming skill.
receiving: METAR sign, cells, missing header/QC, API-only unknown precision, incompatible encoding, duplicate identity and pages, foreign/future reports.
Direct atom-law scoring across every knot and dense grids verifies cell CRPS/gain bounds; paired extrema tighter than separate unrelated intervals.
Legacy point learner byte-structure and legacy observation projections unchanged.
Synthetic paired observations score BEFORE learning and produce changed future mixtures; future score receipts excluded.
Native source pages exact-byte verified; report-cell models published and archived; no order effect.
